supportedRegions.notes: Requires Lambda container image support, API Gateway HTTP API, RDS PostgreSQL, and optional S3 support in the selected region.

requiredPermissions: Provision and mutate Lambda functions, versions, aliases, API Gateway routes, and CloudWatch logs
Provision VPC networking, RDS PostgreSQL, Secrets Manager secrets, KMS keys, and optional S3 buckets
Provision IAM execution roles and ECR read access for container image execution

upgradePath.strategy: Image-based Lambda version publishing with alias promotion
upgradePath.rollback: Repin the live alias to the previous version and reapply
